subject.title: fix(zalo): bound proxy fetcher cache to 64 entries

question: Should plugin authors receive PROXY_FETCH_CLOSE as a permanent low-level SDK contract, or should proxy-fetch disposal be exposed through a higher-level typed helper or lifecycle API?
rationale: Tests establish that disposal works, but they cannot decide which external plugin API OpenClaw should support long term; the repository policy treats new plugin SDK calls as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Use a typed disposal helper
options.body: Keep the metadata symbol internal and export a typed helper that safely disposes supported proxy fetchers.

options.title: Approve the symbol API
options.body: Document PROXY_FETCH_CLOSE as supported plugin API and add focused contract tests for idempotence, in-flight requests, and reuse after closure.

options.title: Keep ownership Zalo-local
options.body: Move ProxyAgent lifecycle ownership into the Zalo plugin and avoid expanding the shared plugin SDK.

recommendation.title: Use a typed disposal helper
recommendation.body: Keep the metadata symbol internal and export a typed helper that safely disposes supported proxy fetchers.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a permanent cross-cutting plugin SDK contract choice rather than a Zalo-only implementation detail.
